description: This file defines a utility class 'NavigationHelper' which provides reusable static methods to handle different navigation flows within the OrangeHRM automation testing framework using Selenium WebDriver. It includes functions for login, logout, page navigation, and session management, primarily used in testing scenarios.

classes.name: NavigationHelper
classes.description: A stateless utility class providing static methods for handling navigation workflows such as login, logout, and page navigation within the OrangeHRM automation framework.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login by navigating to login page, entering credentials, and submitting the login form.

methods.name: loginAsAdmin
methods.description: Performs login as admin user using configuration credentials and waits for dashboard page.

methods.name: loginAsEss
methods.description: Performs login as ESS user using configuration credentials and waits for dashboard page.

methods.name: navigateToLoginPage
methods.description: Navigates to the login page and waits until the login form is visible.

methods.name: navigateToPage
methods.description: Navigates to a specified relative URL path and waits for the page to load.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the current user by interacting with the user dropdown and logout link.

methods.name: clearSession
methods.description: Clears all cookies to reset the session state.

methods.name: isLoggedIn
methods.description: Checks if a user is currently logged in by verifying the presence of the user dropdown.
